description: No audio or original transcript is available to distinguish verbatim teacher speech from editorial reconstruction.
The executable Donchian code and exact order semantics are absent, preventing result reproduction.
The source spreadsheets and formulas used for normalization, ROB and composite sums are not included.
The exact universe membership, survivorship treatment and point-in-time Nasdaq-100 history are not specified.
Vendor data, corporate-action treatment, commissions, borrow constraints and slippage settings are incomplete.
The claimed MultiCharts portfolio-metric bug and adjusted-Sortino convention require external technical verification.
The exact IS/OOS dates and handling of open positions across boundaries are not fully reproducible from the package.
The manual composite score uses discretionary equal weights without a sensitivity analysis for alternative weights.
Whether cluster-derived parameter ranges create selection bias remains explicitly unanswered in the class.
The statement about particle swarm versus genetic algorithms is practitioner judgment without cited comparative evidence.
